commands.stdout:
#!/bin/sh
# Minimal inventory application: periodically emits inventory events to syslog (local0 facility).
i=0
while true; do
  i=$((i+1))
  sku=$(( (i * 37 + $$) % 1000 ))
  logger -t inventory -p local0.info "inventory event seq=$i item=SKU-$sku action=stock_check status=ok"
  sleep 5
done

commands.command:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory application (emits log events to syslog local0)
After=network.target rsyslog.service

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-app.sh
Restart=always
RestartSec=2

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now inventory.service
sleep 1
sudo systemctl status inventory.service --no-pager | head -12
